newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai oil crushers seen seeking 100,000T soybeans.
newsitem.headline: Thai oil crushers seen seeking 100,000T soybeans.

text.p: Thailand's two vegetable oil crushers were recently in the market seeking around 100,000 tonnes of soybeans, trade sources said on Wednesday.
Thanakorn Vegetable Oil was said to seek or have already bought 50,000 tonnes of South American soybean for April shipment. The talk could not be confirmed.
The other major crusher, Thai Vegetable Oil, could be seeking the same amount but for June shipment, the sources said.
